verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Steel serves an llms.txt at docs.steel.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented summary of the product. The docs also offer agent skills an agent can install to control a browser (steel-browser skill, Skill Creator, Session Debugging) and a machine-readable openapi.json. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown docs, and no independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
